scope.summary: Implement style-driven tables of contents: included paragraph styles map to TOC entry styles and levels, with page-number placement (before/after/none) and number character style, between-entry separators, alphabetical sort, run-in vs nested format, include-book-documents, include-hidden-layer text, numbered-paragraph handling, and generate-bookmarks. Multiple TOCs per document MUST be supported (contents, figures, tables, secondary per-section TOCs), each with independent settings, and an update-all-TOCs command refreshes every TOC. TOC entries MUST be able to become live hyperlinks and bookmarks for interactive output (handoff to 14.11). TOC definitions stored as TOC styles in StudioStyleRegistry (MT-168).
proof_targets: TOC generation + update-all runtime; multi-TOC + bookmark test
expected_tests: live: TOC generates from included paragraph styles with levels + page-number placement + separators; update-all refreshes
test: multiple independent TOCs per document; entries become hyperlinks/bookmarks; include-book-documents
acceptance_criteria_original: style-driven TOC with levels/placement/separators/sort/format; multiple TOCs + update-all; hyperlink/bookmark entries

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Tables of contents

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-LAY-044]** Tables of contents MUST be style-driven.
**[STU-LAY-036]** Every named format is a record in the shared `StudioStyleRegistry`.

**[STU-LAY-065]** Layout objects with interactive behaviour -- hyperlinks, bookmarks, buttons, multi-state objects ([STU-LAY-136]), placed media, interactive TOCs ([STU-LAY-148]) and reflowable/fixed-layout EPUB export -- are AUTHORED in this catalog but their runtime interaction model and reflowable export pipeline are owned by 14.11. A layout object's interactive payload MUST be carried on its `StudioLayer` and handed to 14.11 for export; this catalog MUST NOT define a second interactive runtime.

**[STU-LAY-067]** Every capability in this catalog MUST be exposed through BOTH the operator UI and the typed model-steerable command/MCP surface as two projections of one primitive per [STU-DOC-004], MUST satisfy the model-visibility/steerability and parallel-workflow requirements (14.16, 14.17), MUST obey the headless/quiet output law so preflight, package, print, PDF and merge never steal focus or block on a foreground window (14.20), and MUST be represented in the dual-audience UserManual and the GUI/diagnostic and accessibility surfaces (14.22, 14.16). Model-authored layout mutations MUST pass the sandbox -> validation -> `PromotionGate` lifecycle ([STU-ARC-005]) via the propose-work system (14.18) before layout authority rows change. All durable layout authority persists through the canonical Studio SurrealDB tables and `studio.layout` EventLedger events (14.23) under the SurrealDB-only authority guard ([STU-SDB-002]); live collaborative editing is CRDT-backed. This obligation is stated once and is not restated per clause.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
